name: steward
description: One cockpit for Claude Code sessions: context health, cache, usage, handoff, collision and destructive-command guards in a side pane

context.title: Context health
context.description: on: context zones, handoff actions and auto-handoff. off: hidden and inactive.

cache.title: Cache keeper
cache.description: on: estimated prompt-cache countdown and cold-cache warning. off: hidden and inactive.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: on: 5-hour and weekly limits and session cost. off: hidden.

collision.title: Collision guard
collision.description: on: ask before editing a file another session touched recently. off: inactive.

blast.title: Blast radius
blast.description: on: ask before destructive shell and git commands. off: inactive.

pane.title: Open pane at start
pane.description: on: the Steward pane opens when a session starts (wide terminals place it at once; narrow ones wait until you run /steward). off: open it with /steward.

quiet.title: Quiet band
quiet.description: on: while the pane is closed, the line above the prompt shows only when something needs attention. off: it always shows a one-line summary.

amber.title: Amber at (tokens)
amber.description: Context tokens where the amber zone starts. Capped at half the model's window. Default 250000.

red.title: Red at (tokens)
red.description: Context tokens where the red zone starts. Capped at 80% of the auto-compact point (or of the window when auto-compact is off), so red always comes before auto-compact. Default 400000.

briefModel.title: Handoff brief model
briefModel.description: session: the session's own model reads the conversation through the prompt cache (cheapest). sonnet or haiku: a trimmed transcript is sent to that model.

cacheLead.title: Cache warning lead (minutes)
cacheLead.description: How long before the estimated cache expiry Steward sends a notification. 0 turns the warning off. Capped at half the cache window. Default 5.

collisionWindow.title: Collision window (minutes)
collisionWindow.description: Another session's edit to the same file within this many minutes counts as a collision. Default 30.

prices.title: Input prices ($ per million tokens)
prices.description: Overrides for the cold-cache cost estimate, e.g. "opus=4, sonnet-5-5=2". Matched against the model name; built-in list prices (2026-10) are used otherwise. Leave empty for the defaults.

blastPatterns.title: Extra destructive patterns
blastPatterns.description: More commands Blast Radius asks about, separated by ';'. Words must match from the start; * is any one word. Example: kubectl delete; terraform destroy; docker system prune
